chunks: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Masrur (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn 'Amer narrated to us, from al-Mu'alla ibn Muhammad al-Basri, from Ja'far ibn Sulayman, from 'Abdullah ibn al-Hakam, from his father, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Indeed, 'Ali is my deputy and my vicegerent, and his wife Fatima, the Mistress of the Women of the Worlds, is my daughter, and al-Hasan and al-Husayn, the two Masters of the Youth of Paradise, are my two sons. Whoever aligns with them has aligned with me, and whoever opposes them has opposed me, and whoever defies them has defied me, and whoever is aloof with them is aloof with me, and whoever is good to them is good to me. May Allah connect with whoever connects with them, and cut off whoever cuts them off, and support whoever aids them, and cause failure to whoever fails them.

O Allah, each of Your prophets and Your messengers had a heavyweight and a household; so 'Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn are my household and my heavyweight; so remove all uncleanliness from them, and purify them with a thorough purification.

key_terms.الرجس: Rijs - Uncleanliness, impurity; from the Verse of Purification (33:33)
key_terms.ثقل: Thaqal - Heavyweight, weighty thing; refers to the Two Weighty Things (Quran and Ahl al-Bayt)
key_terms.سيدا شباب أهل الجنة: Two Masters of the Youth of Paradise - a title for al-Hasan and al-Husayn
key_terms.سيدة نساء العالمين: Mistress of the Women of the Worlds - an exclusive title for Lady Fatima
key_terms.وصي: Wasi - Deputy, executor of a will, one entrusted with carrying on the mission

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Ali, Fatima, Hasan, and Husayn as his household (Ahl al-Bayt)?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) explicitly declares 'Ali as his deputy and vicegerent, Fatima as the Mistress of the Women of the Worlds, and al-Hasan and al-Husayn as the Masters of the Youth of Paradise. He links the treatment of his household directly to treatment of himself, invoking divine support for those who aid them and divine retribution against those who oppose them. The hadith concludes with the Prophet asking God to purify his Ahl al-Bayt, echoing the Verse of Purification (Quran 33:33). This was narrated through Ibn 'Abbas, one of the most authoritative early Quran commentators, lending significant weight to its content in Shia theological discourse about the Imamate.
word_analysis: may God have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Ja`far b. Muhammad b. Masrur (rh) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. `Amer narrated to us from al-Mu`alla b. Muhammad al-Basri from Ja`far b. Sulayman from `Abdullah b. al-Hakam from his father from Sa`id b. Jubayr from Ibn `Abbas.

He said: The Prophet (s) said: Surely, `Ali is my deputy and my vicegerent. His wife, Fatima, the Mistress of the Women of the Worlds, is my daughter. Al-Hasan and al-Husayn, the two Masters of the Youth of Paradise, are my two sons. Whoever aligns with them has aligned with me, and whoever opposes them has opposed me, and whoever defies them has defied me, and whoever is aloof with them is aloof with me, and whoever is good to them is good to me. Allah will connect with whoever connects with them, and He will cut off whoever cuts them off, and He will support whoever aids them, and He will cause failure to whoever fails them.

O Allah! Each of Your prophets and Your messengers had a heavyweight and a family. So, `Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn are my family and my heavyweight; so, remove all uncleanliness from them, and purify them with a thorough purification.
